title: Ensemble Adapter Manifest Schema
description: Schema for an adapter's `adapter.yaml` (TRD-2026-8d825f54 TRD-005, PRD REQ-005). An adapter is a provider skill directory (`SKILL.md` plus `adapter.yaml`) that implements one or more of the 14 toolchain categories. `adapter.yaml` declares the targeted contract version per category, the binaries and subcommand allowlist the runner may execute, the environment variable names it needs (never literal values, PRD REQ-022), health checks, detection signals, and the run-template plus output-mapping for each capability.

adapter.description: The adapter id, for example 'github' or 'plain-git'. Unique per (id, category) pair, not globally: one id may be split across several directories that declare one category each, so that each carries only the allowlist its own category needs. Resolution is keyed on (id, category), and `npm run validate` rejects the same pair in two directories.

version.description: The adapter's own release version (independent of the per-category contract versions it targets).

categories.description: The toolchain categories this adapter implements; one manifest may implement several (TRD interpretation I7).

contract.description: The 'major.minor' contract version this adapter targets, keyed by category; every entry in 'categories' must have a matching key here (PRD REQ-003).

binaries.description: Binary names this adapter invokes; every argv built from a capability's 'run' template must start with one of these.

bin.description: A binary from 'binaries' this allowlist entry governs.

sub.description: Subcommands of 'bin' the runner may execute (TRD-008 validateAllowlist).

allowlist.description: Per-binary subcommand allowlist; the runner rejects any argv whose binary-plus-subcommand pair is not listed here.

env.description: Required environment variable NAMES only, never literal values (PRD REQ-022, REQ-023); may be empty for adapters needing no credentials.

health.description: Health checks preflight runs before any side-effecting capability (10s default elsewhere, per-adapter override here).

detect.description: Detection signals used to auto-select this adapter when configuration does not name one; may be empty for adapters with no detectable signal (TRD interpretation I2).

run.description: Argv template; '${name}' placeholders are substituted with validated capability arguments (TRD-009), never interpreted by a shell.

parse.description: Output-mapping block: how the capability's stdout is parsed and projected to the category's normalized output shape.

variants.description: Optional per-capability variant run templates keyed by '<selectorArg>: {<value>: run[]}'; the selector arg must be declared as an input of this capability in its category contract (TRD-005 AC).

successExitCodes.description: Child process exit codes (beyond 0, which always succeeds) this capability's runner (`runCapability`) must still treat as a non-crash and continue mapping stdout for, instead of `TOOL_FAILED` (TRD-2026-8d825f54 PR 10 fix round, item 3). For example the shipped `test-runner.run` capability declares `[0, 1]` because its per-language runner scripts exit 1 to report a FAILING test suite, not a crash. Never implies success of the underlying operation by itself -- it only controls whether that exit code's stdout still gets parsed; an exit code outside this list, a signal, a timeout, or stdout that fails to parse at all still resolves `TOOL_FAILED`.

capabilities.description: Capabilities this adapter implements, keyed by '<category>.<capability>' (matching the category contract's capability ids, for example 'tracker.show').
